title: What If We Stopped Changing the Clocks Forever?

scenes.text: What if we stopped changing the clocks forever? Your heart might thank you.
One study reported a 24 percent jump in heart attacks on the Monday after clocks spring forward.
Sleep doctors say the sudden shift disrupts your body clock and brings a spike in road accidents and medical errors.
About 64 percent of US adults would prefer one fixed time all year.
But which time matters. Permanent daylight time keeps winter mornings dark for longer, a problem for school and work.
The American Academy of Sleep Medicine says permanent standard time matches our internal clock best.
